fields.name: Good to know
fields.value: The installers aren't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you the first time: choose *More info*, then *Run anyway*. All three apps update themselves.

rules.title: Server rules
rules.description:
**1. Be decent.** No harassment, hate or personal attacks. Disagree with ideas, not people.

**2. Use the right channel.** Support goes in <#{help}>, bugs in <#{bugs}>, ideas in <#{features}>. Pick the app in the tags.

**3. No piracy.** No links, no requests, no help finding free copies of films, shows, games or software, and no talk of cracked apps. Lumen doesn't host or provide any content and isn't a way around paying for it.

**4. No malware, cracks, keygens or cheats.** Not as files, not as links. Talk about samples with hashes and names only.

**5. Defensive security only.** Discuss how to detect and stop threats, not how to attack other people.

**6. Protect your privacy.** Never post passwords, tokens, API keys (Real-Debrid, VirusTotal or any other) or personal files. Never upload documents, photos or ID scans when reporting a problem.

**7. No spam and no self-promotion** without asking staff first. No unsolicited invites or DMs.

**8. Keep it in English** in the main channels so everyone can follow.

**9. Follow the [Discord Terms](https://discord.com/terms) and [Guidelines](https://discord.com/guidelines).**

**10. Staff have the final say.** If you think a decision was wrong, ask a moderator politely in private.

fields.name: Scam warning
fields.value: Staff will **never** DM you first, ask for a password or API key, or ask you to download something outside the official GitHub releases ([Lumen]({lumenRepo}), [Lumen Studios]({studiosRepo}), [Guardian]({guardianRepo})). If someone does, report them to a moderator.

fields.name: What is Lumen?
fields.value: An app that turns the Stremio addons and Real-Debrid account you already have into one home for movies, series and anime, on Windows, Android and Samsung TV.

fields.name: Does it provide content?
fields.value: No. Lumen doesn't host or provide any content. It shows what your own addons and accounts offer.

fields.name: Is it free? Do I need an account?
fields.value: Free, no ads, no account needed, and it updates itself.

fields.name: Windows says 'Windows protected your PC'
fields.value: The installer isn't code-signed yet. Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

fields.name: Is it free?
fields.value: Yes. No ads, no account and no watermark on your videos.

fields.name: Does it work offline?
fields.value: Editing and exporting work offline. The speech model for automatic captions (about 148 MB) downloads the first time you use that feature, then runs on your PC.

fields.name: What can I import and export?
fields.value: Most common video, photo and audio files import. Export is MP4 (H.264 and AAC). Projects save as .vedit files and captions as .srt.

fields.name: Mac or Linux?
fields.value: Not yet. Lumen Studios is for Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit).

fields.name: Do I need Windows Defender?
fields.value: No. Real-time protection, the quick, folder and deep scans, the hash lists and the signature rules all work without it. If Defender is on, the two work side by side.

fields.name: Is it a kernel-level antivirus?
fields.value: No. Guardian has no kernel driver. With administrator rights it listens to Windows' own kernel process events, so it sees every program within moments of it starting and can pause a risky one, but it can't stop a program before its first instruction. That needs a Microsoft-signed driver and a paid certificate.

fields.name: Does it upload my files?
fields.value: Never. The optional VirusTotal check sends only a file's SHA-256 fingerprint, and only if you turn it on and add your own key.

fields.name: Can it delete a good file by mistake?
fields.value: It never deletes. Quarantine moves a file aside and you can restore it. 'It's fine' stops a file being raised again.

fields.name: Where are its files?
fields.value: Settings, history and quarantine live in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Guardian`. If something breaks, the end of `errors.log` in that folder is what we need.

fields.name: 🎞 Lumen
fields.value: A home screen built from your addons with Continue watching and a Top 10, a player that fixes Dolby and DTS sound, Watch together, profiles with a kids mode behind a PIN, anime and series calendars, 15 themes, 5 languages, Play on TV, and apps for Windows, Android and Samsung TV.

fields.name: ✂️ Lumen Studios
fields.value: A multi-track timeline, text and stickers, 75+ effects, 94 transitions, filters, automatic captions, 32 templates, HDR tone mapping and frame-accurate MP4 export.

fields.name: 🛡️ Guardian
fields.value: Its own scan engine (quick, folder and deep scans), real-time protection that also checks programs as they start, 9,000+ known-bad hashes and 5,000+ YARA rules, plus registry repair, cleanup, drivers, debloat and a safe BIOS update assistant.

roadmap.title: Ideas on the table
roadmap.description: These are ideas people ask for. They are **not promises** and have no dates.

fields.name: Code-signed installers
fields.value: Would remove the SmartScreen warning. Needs a paid certificate.

fields.name: Mac and Linux versions
fields.value: Asked for often. The apps would need new interfaces and parts rewritten.

fields.name: A Guardian kernel driver
fields.value: Would let Guardian block programs before they start. Needs a Microsoft-signed driver, which needs a paid certificate.

fields.name: Your idea
fields.value: Post it in <#{features}> and pick the app.

howitworks.title: How Guardian works
howitworks.description: Four steps, every time something new shows up on your PC.

fields.name: 1. Catch
fields.value: Watchers see new files in Downloads, the desktop, temp and startup folders, new startup entries, USB drives and, as administrator, every program the moment it starts (through Windows' own kernel process events).

fields.name: 2. Inspect
fields.value: The engine checks the digital signature, where the file lives and how it behaves, then 9,000+ known-bad fingerprints and 5,000+ YARA rules. All of it runs on your PC. A rule match counts as evidence weighed against the rule's confidence and the file's signature, never as a verdict by itself.

fields.name: 3. Decide
fields.value: Anything medium-risk or worse becomes an alert with the reasons in plain words. Optionally Guardian quarantines serious threats or pauses a high-risk program until you decide.

fields.name: 4. Undo
fields.value: Quarantine moves a file aside and never deletes it. Restore it any time. Every alert stays in your history.

howitworks.footer: Guardian never opens your documents, photos or ID scans, and never uploads your files.
